title: 实现证据的当前性按受关注路径内容判断，而不是仅按仓库 HEAD 是否移动
summary: 不可变 revision 证明历史证据；当前仍适用与否应额外比较声明的实现源文件在当前 HEAD 的 Git blob identity。文档、CI 或 .uigs 元数据等无关提交使 revision != HEAD 时，不应自动把未变化的实现标成 stale。
principles: Historical provenance and current implementation state are separate questions.
Immutable revision + blob identity proves what was observed.
Repository HEAD equality is coarse context, not sufficient implementation currentness.
Currentness is computed over explicitly declared source paths; validation paths are reported separately.
A missing or changed current source path marks current implementation evidence stale without erasing historical evidence.
